# Orientation — the 10-minute tour

ticketd is a small internal ticket tracker: create a ticket, list/filter them, close one, done —
plus a password-reset flow bolted on for whatever login story exists around it (the app itself
has no visible auth layer at all, see `then-vs-now.md` and `docs/open-questions.md#OQ-004`).
It's being rewritten to FastAPI + PostgreSQL for two concrete reasons named by whoever
commissioned this: notification emails currently block the request that triggers them, and
password-reset tokens are generated with MD5. Everything else in this guide is what a systematic
read of a 165-line codebase turned up along the way — some of it matters, some of it is just
honestly documented weirdness nobody asked to fix.
